proposals.title: Gender pay equity report
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Rainer Yingling Judd
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's global median gender pay gap, including associated policy, reputational, competitive, operational risks and risks related to recruiting and retaining female talent.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Enhance shareholder proxy access
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, as agent for Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend proxy access bylaws so proxy access director candidates need not obtain a specific percentage vote to qualify as candidates at future meetings.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Cumulative voting
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt cumulative voting for director elections so shareholders may cast cumulated votes for single or few director candidates.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
